# vendor/

`tetravox-module-sdk-1-0.8.0.tgz` is the SDK emitted by `node scripts/emit-module-sdk.mjs` from Tetravox branch
`feat/tract-platform` (uncommitted tree of 2026-11-05: `scene.tracts.scan` and `attachFile`, `scene.openFile`, `files.chooseFolder`, panel tabs). The SDK of the published 0.8.0 has none of them, so this
file is required until a Tetravox release carries it. Then the dependency becomes that release's asset URL and this
directory goes away.
